notes.demo_account: N/A: Onda has no accounts or login.
notes.live_backend: N/A: Onda has no developer-operated backend; it queries public radio-browser.info, Apple iTunes Search API, and broadcaster/RSS feeds directly.
notes.review_notes: Complete Foreground Service (mediaPlayback) declaration and Android Auto opt-in in Play Console before promoting past Internal Testing.
notes.screenshots_match_build: Required when creating Closed/Production store listing; keep third-party station trademarks out of listing assets.
notes.account_deletion_device_test: N/A: Onda does not create or store user accounts.
notes.privacy_labels_match_runtime: Verify Play Console Data Safety form against docs/privacy-policy.md before submitting.
notes.iap_reachable_by_reviewer: N/A: Onda is completely free with no in-app purchases, subscriptions, or ads.
